title: L14 / C15: indirect auth, cache and polling effects of lag fixes
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/C15-LAG-INDIRECT-EFFECTS-AND-TESTS.md, pinned to lag-1 auth, #343 and #344 independently, with effect/source/retest/evidence matrix and blank reviewer pass sheet.

Covers extra auth RPCs and changed early-redirect/throw/slow-call timing, role/company/MFA/cookies, unchanged cache mechanisms, dashboard burst/read-clock/pool effects, 5-minute jobs live-state polling versus full list reload, hidden timer versus in-flight/coalesced/sync traffic, offline scopes, named fields/export/print, shared pagination/cap changes and comparable test-only measurements. #343 remains documentation-only, not an implemented customer/time speedup.

Source/diff/immutable-line and whitespace checks pass. Handover embedded; combined browser/runtime/load/latency proof remains open. No original implementation edits, new scope, main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
